name: third-party-review
description: Have an agent without the implementation context review your pull request, and hand its findings back through a result file.

interface.shortDescription: Get a review from an agent that never saw the implementation.
interface.longDescription: Reviewing your own work in the session that produced it carries every assumption forward. This hands the pull request to a reviewer that starts cold, gives it nothing but the repository name and the pull request number, and collects the findings in a result file so nothing is posted to GitHub without the author seeing it first.
